contact.basis: Original elevation at the plaza-side approach in the mapped main elevation frame.

verticalDatum: Geospatial Information Authority of Japan Fundamental Geospatial Data DEM5A elevation in metres.
attribution: Edited from GSI Tiles, elevation tiles (Fundamental Geospatial Data DEM5A), Geospatial Information Authority of Japan.
method: Original GSI centimetre-encoded RGB24 bytes bilinearly sampled at pixel centres in fixed original Tokyo Metropolitan Government Main Building No. 1 site-context frame with explicitly approximate component registration. Independent fine-terrain source, preserved without flattening or fitting.
limitations: DEM5A is a five-metre sampling grid. The 2 m review grid is an interpolation.
The GSI data and review grid provide ground elevation and approximate registration at the civic plaza.
